title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 9, 2026

sections.name: 머리말
sections.html: Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.

sections.name: Balance Update
sections.html:
Heroes

Chromie

Talents

  • Level 1
    • Once Again the First Time
      • Damage increased from 50% to 55%.
    • Deep Breathing
      • Damage bonus per stack increased from 0.5% to 0.6%.
    • Timewalker's Pursuit
      • Damage bonus reduced from 15% to 12%.

Gazlowe

Base

  • Basic Attack damage increased from 100 to 105.
  • Health increased from 2275 to 2375.
  • Deth Lazor [W]
    • Life Leech increased from 25% to 30%.

Talents

  • Level 20
    • Bomb Toss
      • No longer grants an additional charge.

Greymane

Talents

  • Level 7
    • Incendiary Elixir
      • Damage bonus per stack increased from 25 to 30.
  • Level 20
    • Gilnean Roulette
      • No longer reduces the percentage based Health damage.

Lúcio

Talents

  • Level 1
    • Party Mix
      • Quest completion radius bonus increased from 20% to 30%.
  • Level 10
    • Sound Barrier
      • Shield amount per stack increased from 27 to 31.
  • Level 13
    • Slip
      • Lingering duration increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
  • Level 20
    • Summer Anthem
      • Unkillable duration increased from 1.5 to 2.5 seconds.

Medivh

Base

  • Arcane Rift [Q]
    • Damage increased from 170 to 185.
  • Force of Will [W]
    • Cooldown reduced from 9 to 8 seconds.
  • Portal [E]
    • Cooldown increased from 16 to 20 seconds.

Talents

  • Level 1
    • Winds of Celerity
      • Now also reduces cast time by 0.25 seconds.
    • Raven's Intellect
      • Bonus increased from 200% to 400%.
    • Portal Mastery
      • No longer allows Medivh to cast Portal in Raven Form without dismounting.
  • Level 4
    • Dust of Appearance
      • Cooldown reduced from 45 to 40 seconds.
      • Now allows Medivh to cast Portal in Raven Form without dismounting.

Mei

Base

  • Blizzard [W]
    • Detonation delay reduced from 2 to 1.875 seconds.
    • Detonation damage increased from 75 to 80.
  • Icing [E]
    • Cast time reduced from 0.625 to 0.5 seconds.

Talents

  • Level 10
    • Avalanche
      • Cooldown reduced from 90 to 80 seconds.
    • Ice Wall
      • Cast time reduced from 0.75 to 0.6875 seconds.

Mephisto

Talents

  • Level 1
    • Malicious Intent
      • Spell Power bonus increased from 25% to 30%.
      • Duration increased from 2.5 to 3 seconds.
  • Level 4
    • Hateful Mending
      • Mana restored increased from 10 to 15.
      • Healing increased from 70% to 85%.
    • Static Barrier
      • Shield amount increased from 40% to 50%.

Stukov

Talents

  • Level 1
    • Fetid Touch
      • Cooldown reduction increased from 5 to 6 seconds.
  • Level 10
    • Flailing Swipe
      • Damage increased from 48 to 62.

Xal'atath

Base

  • Shadow Mark [Q]
    • Range increased from 8 to 9.
  • Dark Heart Ritual [W]
    • Detonation damage increased from 245 to 260.
  • Void Volley [D]
    • Mythic Reward damage bonus reduced from 50% to 35%.

Talents

  • Level 1
    • Anchored Core
      • No longer increases duration.
    • Cloak of Shadows
      • Now grants Spell Armor only while actively blinking. The bonus no longer persists for 2 seconds.
  • Level 4
    • Cold Feet
      • Duration bonus increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
  • Level 7
    • Toxic Mark
      • No longer increases debuff duration.
      • Now benefits from Cold Feet's duration bonus.
  • Level 10
    • Void Eruption
      • Damage per second reduced by 10%.
      • Speed reduced by 10%.
  • Level 16
    • Marked Resilience
      • Shield amount increased from 160 to 200.
    • Relentless Whispers
      • No longer increases Attack Speed.
      • Now grants an additional 75% Basic Attack damage per teleport.
    • Fractured Reality
      • Damage bonus reduced from 25% to 15%.
  • Level 20
    • Harbinger's Consumption
      • Cooldown reduction per hit reduced from 14 to 10 seconds.
      • The three orbs now orbit more slowly.
    • Unstable Core
      • No longer applies a damage over time to targets.
      • Impact damage increased from 45 to 75.

Return to Top

sections.name: Bug Fixes
sections.html:
General

  • Fixed an issue with the death icon at certain resolutions. Begone pesky pixel!
  • Spell Power no longer increases the Health restored by activating Hearthstone (B).
  • Fixed an issue with allied pings on the Party Frame.

Maps

  • Fixed an issue that caused Sapper attacks to instantly hit nearby targets.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sapper warning areas to persist indefinitely.
  • Auriel
    • Level 16
      • Wrath of Heaven
        • Fixed an issue that caused Wrath of Heaven's full Spell Power bonus to apply to healing.
  • Blaze
    • Level 13
      • Adhesive Petroleum
        • Fixed an issue that caused Adhesive Petroleum to grant its Basic Attack damage bonus to other Blaze players who do not have the talent selected.
  • Genji
    • Level 1
      • Pathfinder
        • Fixed an issue that caused Genji to no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after Pathfinder expires.
  • Greymane
    • Level 4
      • Eyes in the Dark
        • Fixed an issue that caused Genji to no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after Eyes in the Dark expires.
  • Li Li
    • Base
      • Cloud Serpent [W]
        • Fixed an issue that allowed Cloud Serpent casts on allied Heroes to become disjointed.
  • Medivh
    • Level 13
      • Circle of Protection
        • Added a radius indicator to Force of Will's cast guide after selecting Circle of Protection.
    • Level 20
      • Dust of Disappearance
        • Fixed an issue that caused targeted allies to not automatically acquire nearby targets after Stealth expires.
  • Tassadar
    • Level 13
      • Shadow Walk
        • Fixed an issue that caused Tassadar to no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after Shadow Walk expires.
  • Xal'atath
    • Base
      • Fixed an issue with Xal'atath's Health Regeneration.
      • Shadow Mark [Q]
        • Fixed issues that caused Structures to be marked by Shadow Mark in unintended situations.
      • Dark Heart Ritual [W]
        • Fixed issues related to Dark Heart Ritual's self reveal logic.
      • Void Volley [D]
        • Fixed an issue that caused Void Volley to gain progress when attacking a target with 1 Evasion charge remaining.
    • Level 4
      • Void Acolyte
        • Fixed an issue that caused Void Acolyte to not empower Void Volley.
    • Level 7
      • Void Summoner
        • Fixed an issue that caused Void Summoner to not spawn the Void Minion at Xal'atath's position at cast time.
  • Xul
    • Base
      • Bone Prison [E]
        • Xul will no longer be revealed to the enemy if he is in the fog of war when Bone Prison activates.

Return to Top

Click here to discuss this post with other players in the official Heroes of the Storm forums.
